public_rationale: Contemporaneous evidence supports substantial compositional weaknesses, but also documents strong compositional performance under structured prompting. Neither result settles the broad ordinary reading about reliability across foundation models. An absolute claim that these models have no compositional ability would fare worse; a claim about lacking explicit semantic machinery would require a different test. Choosing either reading would materially determine the verdict.
limitations: The studies test different models, tasks and prompting conditions.
SCAN success does not establish unrestricted natural-language understanding.
Zero-shot failures do not prove that relevant capabilities or representations are absent.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Foundation models such as GPT-3 and BERT sidestep compositionality.

statement.excerpt: Compositionality has long been a central concept in linguistics and philosophy (even Aristotle acknowledged it), yet so-called foundation models (large language models, GPT-3, BERT, deep learning approaches) sidestep it.
statement.document_title: Three ideas from linguistics that everyone in AI should know

from_speaker: large language models, GPT-3, BERT, deep learning approaches
our_interpretation: In the surrounding examples, the ordinary behavioral reading is that these models do not reliably preserve the meanings of parts and their arrangement when interpreting novel combinations.
This reading does not equate the absence of a hand-coded semantic module with the absence of learned compositional ability.
Sidestep could instead describe architecture or training objectives; those readings are recorded separately rather than silently substituted.
Current models are assessed over the current calendar year through publication, 2022-01-01 to 2022-06-22, because model evaluations have no regular reporting period.
The assessment addresses the normalized proposition about foundation models, not the historical aside about Aristotle.
criteria.support_condition: Representative evaluations of contemporary foundation models establish systematic failure to preserve part meanings and their relations across novel combinations.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative evaluations of contemporary foundation models establish reliable compositional interpretation across controlled novel combinations. A narrow task success qualifies an absolute dismissal but does not alone establish general reliability.

evidence.explanation: The tested pretrained models showed important compositional weaknesses without task examples. The paper also reports strong improvements after fine-tuning, so the result supports a reliability concern rather than an absence of all compositional capacity.

evidence.excerpt: least-to-most prompting achieves an accuracy of 99.7%.
evidence.explanation: A contemporary GPT-3 model performed strongly on SCAN's length generalization split using structured decomposition prompts, Python notation and postprocessing. This materially challenges an absolute dismissal, but the narrow, assisted setup does not settle general compositional reliability.
